name: planning
description: Expert in project planning and management, using methodologies like Agile and tools for risk assessment and timelines.

name: implement-agent
description: A subagent specialized in implementing code changes, creating, modifying, and deleting files, and handling text-related tasks in codebases.

name: tester-agent
description: Expert at testing scripts, environments, and other testing-related tasks.

name: analyser-agent
description: Expert at analyzing issues, log files, and other data to explain problems, suggest fixes, and provide actionable next steps.

name: github-agent
description: Expert subagent for GitHub PR management, GitHub Copilot CLI integration, code reviews, and repository operations.

name: optimizations
description: Expert in code optimizations, focusing on performance, memory, and algorithmic improvements.

name: internet-researcher
description: Expert at researching topics on the internet and providing concise, accurate summaries of findings.

name: pr-review
description: Expert in pull request reviews, focusing on code quality, best practices, and adherence to project standards.

name: subagent-creator
description: Creates new subagents by generating and writing valid Markdown configuration files to the agents folder

name: helper-script-expert
description: Expert in creating and executing helper scripts (Bash, Python, etc.) to assist the primary agent with tasks like file manipulation, data processing, or tool automation when direct tool use is inefficient.

name: workflow-log-expert
description: Expert at examining GitHub workflow logs, identifying issues, and suggesting fixes
